verdict.rationale: Rive is a SaaS design and animation platform with AI agent, MCP and CLI tooling, so recurring scheduled automation is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature. MCP tools that 'handle repetitive tasks' are one-off agent actions, and automatic saving is not a user-defined recurring schedule, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
